title: 隧道超前探測鑽孔~Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces
focus: 以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型~Build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence
summary: 本課聚焦以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 探測目標與盲區~Targets and blind zones
units.title: 探測目標與盲區~Targets and blind zones
units.mechanism: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。 假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。~A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long. Separate the questions of lithological boundaries, water-bearing zones and voids, then check whether the planned trajectories actually intersect each target. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.
units.verify: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。~Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion.
units.failure: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。~Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.
units.misconception: 鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。~Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
units.practice: 調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。~Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.

units.anchor: 孔跡與角度誤差~Trajectory and angular error
units.title: 孔跡與角度誤差~Trajectory and angular error
units.mechanism: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。 假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。~Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction. A small angular bias produces a substantial positional difference over a long hole, so an interpreted contact needs trajectory quality as well as rod length. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation.
units.verify: 使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。把正反向讀值和已知控制段比較，釐清系統偏差；地層位置的允收精度須由調查目的訂定，不能只引用儀器型錄精度。~Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey. Retain station spacing and compare reverse readings with a known control interval. Specify acceptable contact-location uncertainty from the investigation purpose rather than the instrument brochure alone.
units.failure: 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。~Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness.
units.misconception: 孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。~A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
units.practice: 交接孔跡時提供原始角度、坐標基準、修正方法及誤差範圍，讓設計者重建地層位置；大於目的精度的偏差由測量主管核准處置。~Deliver raw angles, coordinate datum, correction method and uncertainty so the designer can reconstruct contacts; the survey lead must resolve deviations exceeding the purpose-specific positional requirement.

units.anchor: 鑽進比能辨識~Drilling specific energy
units.title: 鑽進比能辨識~Drilling specific energy
units.mechanism: 扭矩與轉速提供破岩功率，除以切削體積速率得到旋轉比能。比能上升可能來自硬岩，也可能是磨鈍鑽頭、孔壁摩擦或堵塞；只有在鑽具與操作條件可比時，才可把趨勢視為地質線索。 假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。~Torque and rotation give cutting power, which divided by excavated volume rate gives rotational specific energy. Rising energy may indicate harder rock, but also a worn bit, wall friction or blockage. Geological interpretation therefore requires comparable tooling and operating conditions. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work. Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work.
units.verify: 將扭矩、轉速、推力、進尺與換鑽頭時間同步繪圖，與岩屑及岩心描述比較。先剔除接桿與空轉段，再確認感測器量程及時間戳；若訊號變化只跟換具同時發生，不接受為地層界面的獨立證據。~Synchronize torque, speed, thrust, penetration and bit-change times with cuttings and core descriptions. Exclude rod changes and idle rotation, then check sensor range and timestamps. A change coincident only with tool replacement is not accepted as independent evidence of a geological contact.
units.failure: 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。~Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations.
units.misconception: 比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。~Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
units.practice: 以同一鑽頭生命週期建立比較基線，把維護事件列在地質日誌旁；未經場址校準的能量指標只可作為取樣優先順序。~Build comparison baselines within a single bit life and place maintenance events beside the geology log; an uncalibrated energy index may prioritize sampling but cannot replace strength testing.

units.anchor: 岩屑輸送延遲~Cuttings transport lag
units.title: 岩屑輸送延遲~Cuttings transport lag
units.mechanism: 岩屑到達孔口時已落後鑽頭位置，且不同粒徑在回流中速度不同。若依回收時間直接指定地層深度，薄弱夾層會被向深處平移並混合；回流路徑、流量與沉積需要共同解釋。 假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。~Cuttings arrive at the collar after the bit has advanced, and different sizes travel at different speeds. Assigning depth from recovery time alone displaces and mixes thin layers. Return-path volume, flow and settling must be interpreted together. With assumed return volume 0.15 m³ and flow 0.003 m³/s, mean delay is 50 s; advancement at 0.01 m/s shifts assigned depth by 0.50 m. Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. Thin layers can be averaged away, producing a precise-looking warning chainage after the critical interval has passed.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed return volume 0.15 m³ and flow 0.003 m³/s, mean delay is 50 s; advancement at 0.01 m/s shifts assigned depth by 0.50 m.
units.verify: 把流量計、鑽進記錄與取樣時鐘同步，利用可辨識岩性轉換核對延遲估算。記錄混樣範圍而非單一深度，並與相鄰岩心孔比對；當回流間斷或孔內沉積增加時，原先的定值延遲修正必須重新評估。~Synchronize flow metering, drilling records and sample clocks, checking estimated delay against identifiable lithological transitions. Record a mixing interval rather than a single depth and compare an adjacent core hole. Reassess a constant lag correction when returns become intermittent or downhole settling increases.
units.failure: 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。~Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. Thin layers can be averaged away, producing a precise-looking warning chainage after the critical interval has passed.
units.misconception: 岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。~Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth.
units.practice: 取樣標籤同時保留回收時間、估計來源深度區間和回流狀態；無法校正的混樣交由地質師判定用途，不作精確界面定位。~Sample labels must retain recovery time, estimated source interval and return condition; the geologist decides uses for unresolved mixed samples, which cannot locate a precise contact.

units.title: 返水流量收支~Return-flow balance
units.mechanism: 進水與返水差額反映孔內儲存、裂隙吸水或外部湧入的合成效應，並不是裂隙滲透係數本身。鑽進速度與孔內容積變化會使短時間收支失衡，應先閉合水量帳再提出水文假說。 假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。 流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。~The difference between supply and return reflects changing storage, fracture losses and external inflow, not permeability alone. Advancement and changing hole volume disturb short-term balance. Close the water account before proposing a hydrogeological interpretation. Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow. Meter zero drift can create false inflow, while missed returns conceal real inflow. Extrapolating an unclosed water balance into tunnel-wide inflow gives a misleading treatment-capacity estimate.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow.
units.verify: 以校準容積槽或流量計核對供回水兩側，註記接桿、停機及沖洗時段。比較同長時間窗的累積量並估計孔內儲存變化；水文工程師只有在穩態條件及漏失路徑獲得確認後，才接受該差額作為外來水證據。~Check both supply and return using calibrated tanks or meters and mark rod changes, stoppages and flushing. Compare cumulative quantities over matching windows and estimate storage changes. The hydrogeologist accepts the difference as external inflow evidence only after confirming steady conditions and accounting for losses.
units.failure: 流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。~Meter zero drift can create false inflow, while missed returns conceal real inflow. Extrapolating an unclosed water balance into tunnel-wide inflow gives a misleading treatment-capacity estimate.
units.misconception: 返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。~Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow.
units.practice: 把水量平衡與地層里程分開保留原始檔，異常先查儀器與儲存再查地質；新增水文風險由主管工程師審查後調整預案。~Keep original water balances and geology chainage separately; investigate instruments and storage before attributing anomalies to geology, and obtain engineering review before changing the water-risk response.

units.anchor: 水頭與壓力換算~Head and pressure conversion
units.title: 水頭與壓力換算~Head and pressure conversion
units.mechanism: 量到的孔口壓力須配合高程基準才能形成水頭；壓力水頭與高程水頭不能任選其一。停流壓力也會受管路損失與等待時間影響，故量測系統和地下水系統必須分開建模。 假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。 只比較不同高程的表壓可能把同一水頭誤判成壓力異常；殘留氣泡或管路堵塞又會拖慢響應，使停流後的短暫值被當成原位水壓。~Collar pressure requires a common elevation datum to become hydraulic head; pressure head and elevation head are complementary. Shut-in readings depend on line losses and equilibration time, so distinguish the measuring system from the groundwater system. For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head. Comparing gauge pressures at different elevations can falsely indicate anomalous groundwater. Air bubbles or blocked lines delay response and make a transient shut-in value appear to be in-situ pressure.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head.
units.verify: 使用有校準紀錄的壓力感測器並測定其高程，圖示觀測時間與壓力變化是否趨平。以第二量程或獨立水位觀測查核，將淡水密度及溫度假設列入誤差表；量到穩定數值仍需工程師確認測點與目標含水層的連通性。~Use a calibrated pressure sensor with surveyed elevation and plot stabilization over time. Check with a second range or independent water-level observation, documenting density and temperature assumptions. A stable number still requires engineering confirmation that the observation communicates with the intended water-bearing zone.
units.failure: 只比較不同高程的表壓可能把同一水頭誤判成壓力異常；殘留氣泡或管路堵塞又會拖慢響應，使停流後的短暫值被當成原位水壓。~Comparing gauge pressures at different elevations can falsely indicate anomalous groundwater. Air bubbles or blocked lines delay response and make a transient shut-in value appear to be in-situ pressure.
units.misconception: 兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。~Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
units.practice: 所有壓力圖均標示感測器高程、壓力種類與等待時間；涉及帶壓孔口的工作只由核准專業程序執行，本課換算不是操作許可。~Every pressure plot must identify sensor elevation, pressure convention and waiting time; work at a pressurized collar requires an approved specialist procedure, not authorization from this calculation.

units.anchor: 裂隙導水與尺度~Fracture flow and scale
units.title: 裂隙導水與尺度~Fracture flow and scale
units.mechanism: 單孔試驗只感受到與孔壁連通的裂隙網路，遠方未連通的高導水帶不一定被看見。等效滲透係數把複雜通道平均化，流速與邊界條件改變後，該平均值未必仍可直接移用。 假設Darcy條件k=10⁻⁶ m/s、面積2 m²、梯度5，Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s；裂隙慣性流不適用。 若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。~A single-hole test senses fractures connected to its wall and may miss a distant conductive zone. Equivalent permeability averages a complex channel network. Changing velocity or boundaries can invalidate transfer of that average to a different scale. Assume Darcy conditions with k=10⁻⁶ m/s, area 2 m² and gradient 5. Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s; inertial fracture flow falls outside this model. A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. Conversely, disturbance at the borehole wall may exaggerate connectivity that is absent in the undisturbed rock mass.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Darcy條件k=10⁻⁶ m/s、面積2 m²、梯度5，Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s；裂隙慣性流不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Darcy conditions with k=10⁻⁶ m/s, area 2 m² and gradient 5. Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s; inertial fracture flow falls outside this model.
units.verify: 把試驗區間、壓差與流量同圖呈現，檢查升降階段是否可逆並與孔內影像的裂隙位置比較。量測結果應附模型、觀測尺度及邊界條件；若關係非線性或出現滯後，不以單一斜率當成可外推的材料常數。~Plot test interval, differential pressure and flow together, checking reversibility and comparing imaged fractures. Report model, scale and boundary conditions with the result. Nonlinearity or hysteresis prevents one fitted slope from being accepted as a transferable material constant.
units.failure: 若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。~A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. Conversely, disturbance at the borehole wall may exaggerate connectivity that is absent in the undisturbed rock mass.
units.misconception: 單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。~A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel.
units.practice: 報告同時交付原始流量壓力曲線與可替代模型，要求水文工程師說明尺度轉換依據；不把本課的假設梯度當作試驗壓力。~Deliver raw pressure-flow curves with alternative interpretations and require a hydrogeologist to justify scale transfer; the assumed gradient in this exercise is not a test-pressure instruction.

units.anchor: 多證據更新機率~Updating with multiple evidence
units.title: 多證據更新機率~Updating with multiple evidence
units.mechanism: 異常訊號可能是假陽性，無異常也可能是假陰性，解釋價值取決於先驗地質風險。震波與鑽孔若共享同一位置模型，兩者誤差可能相關，不能因資料來自兩種儀器就當成獨立證據。 假設危險帶先驗0.2、靈敏度0.8、假陽性0.1，陽性後機率=0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667。 只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。~Anomalies can be false positives and quiet records false negatives, so evidence depends on prior geological risk. Seismic and drilling interpretations may share a location model and correlated errors; different instruments do not automatically provide independent evidence. Assume prior hazard probability 0.2, sensitivity 0.8 and false-positive rate 0.1. Probability after a positive is 0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667. Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. Multiplying correlated evidence compounds overconfidence and can remove additional investigation that the unresolved ground conditions still require.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設危險帶先驗0.2、靈敏度0.8、假陽性0.1，陽性後機率=0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume prior hazard probability 0.2, sensitivity 0.8 and false-positive rate 0.1. Probability after a positive is 0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667.
units.verify: 用事前凍結的判釋準則對照後續揭露的地質，分別記錄命中、漏判與假警報。審查樣本是否只收集已知異常區，並列出各證據共同依賴的資料；未有場址驗證前，機率數字只用於教學敏感度比較。~Compare a predeclared interpretation rule with subsequently exposed geology, counting hits, misses and false alarms separately. Check whether samples include only known anomalies and list shared dependencies. Before site validation, probability values serve teaching sensitivity analysis rather than calibrated operational prediction.
units.failure: 只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。~Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. Multiplying correlated evidence compounds overconfidence and can remove additional investigation that the unresolved ground conditions still require.
units.misconception: 兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。~No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
units.practice: 預先保存判讀時間與版本，以開挖揭露結果做盲對照；風險降低的結論須由負責地質與施工的工程師共同審查。~Preserve interpretation timestamps and versions for blind comparison with later exposure; any conclusion that risk has reduced requires joint review by the responsible geology and construction engineers.

units.anchor: 取樣品質與回收~Sampling quality and recovery
units.title: 取樣品質與回收~Sampling quality and recovery
units.mechanism: 岩心回收率衡量取回多少材料，並不直接等於原位完整程度。軟弱夾層更容易被沖失，留下的硬塊會造成選樣偏差；應把流失深度區間視為資訊缺口，而非自動補成堅硬岩石。 假設單回次長2.0 m、取回1.6 m，回收率=1.6/2.0=80%；遺失0.4 m仍需定位不確定性。 只測試取回的完整岩心會得到偏高強度分布，且缺失區若位置放錯，薄弱面可能被藏入別的回次；支護分類因而過度樂觀。~Core recovery measures material retrieved, not in-situ integrity. Weak layers preferentially wash out, leaving a biased sample of stronger pieces. Missing intervals are evidence gaps and must not be filled automatically with the properties of the remaining rock. For an assumed 2.0 m run with 1.6 m recovered, recovery is 80%; the missing 0.4 m retains positional uncertainty. Testing only intact recovered pieces biases the strength distribution upward. Misplacing lost material can hide a weak plane in another run and produce an unjustifiably favorable support classification.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設單回次長2.0 m、取回1.6 m，回收率=1.6/2.0=80%；遺失0.4 m仍需定位不確定性。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 2.0 m run with 1.6 m recovered, recovery is 80%; the missing 0.4 m retains positional uncertainty.
units.verify: 將鑽進長度、岩心實長、破碎端面與沖洗紀錄一起核對，攝影保留比例尺和回次標記。以孔內影像或相鄰孔檢查缺失區是否對應弱層；回收率不足時，設計用強度樣本必須註明其對弱層的代表性限制。~Reconcile advance, recovered length, broken ends and flushing records, photographing scale and run markers. Compare imaging or adjacent holes to determine whether loss corresponds to a weak layer. Strength samples from incomplete recovery must disclose their limited representation of the missing material.
units.failure: 只測試取回的完整岩心會得到偏高強度分布，且缺失區若位置放錯，薄弱面可能被藏入別的回次；支護分類因而過度樂觀。~Testing only intact recovered pieces biases the strength distribution upward. Misplacing lost material can hide a weak plane in another run and produce an unjustifiably favorable support classification.
units.misconception: 回收率高就能證明岩體沒有節理或軟弱夾層。~High core recovery proves that the rock mass has no joints or weak interbeds.
units.practice: 岩心箱與數位記錄使用同一孔號回次，缺失區不得以推測材料替補；代表性不足的試驗資料需地質師註記後才可交付設計。~Core boxes and digital logs must share hole and run identifiers; never replace lost intervals with inferred material, and require the geologist to flag unrepresentative tests before design handover.

units.title: 調查到開挖交接~Investigation-to-excavation handover
units.mechanism: 調查價值在於改變可追溯的工程判斷，而非累積孔數。把預測界面、信心範圍與後續揭露逐段對照，可辨別地質模型是否隨開挖失效；觀測條件變化時，應保留舊版本以解釋當時決策。 假設10項待回答地質問題中有8項獲獨立證據，證據完成率80%；其餘2項不能按平均分數判成通過。 缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。~Investigation matters when it changes a traceable engineering decision. Comparing predicted contacts, uncertainty intervals and later exposure reveals when a ground model stops being adequate. Retain previous versions so changing observations do not erase the evidence available at each decision. If independent evidence addresses 8 of 10 assumed geological questions, evidence completion is 80%; the remaining 2 cannot be accepted through an average score. Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location. Burying unresolved risks inside a completion percentage can imply that all adverse conditions have been excluded.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項待回答地質問題中有8項獲獨立證據，證據完成率80%；其餘2項不能按平均分數判成通過。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If independent evidence addresses 8 of 10 assumed geological questions, evidence completion is 80%; the remaining 2 cannot be accepted through an average score.
units.verify: 逐項核對問題清單、孔號、原始觀測與設計影響，抽一筆資料從圖面追溯到感測器或岩心箱。以後續掌子面記錄驗證預測，將未解決項列成責任與期限；主管工程師依具體風險而非整體完成率核准進入下一審查節點。~Audit each question against hole identifiers, raw observations and design consequences, tracing a sample drawing back to sensor records or the core box. Check predictions against later face logs and assign owners and deadlines to unresolved items. Approval depends on the specific remaining risk, not overall completion percentage.
units.failure: 缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。~Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location. Burying unresolved risks inside a completion percentage can imply that all adverse conditions have been excluded.
units.misconception: 調查報告交付百分之百就等於所有地質風險已消失。~Delivering the entire investigation report means all geological risk has disappeared.
units.practice: 交接表分列已證實、推論及未解決項目，附適用里程與失效條件；地質、設計及施工負責人共同確認控制措施的更新責任。~The handover separates observations, interpretations and unresolved items with chainage and invalidation conditions; geology, design and construction leads jointly confirm responsibility for updating the controls.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.

教學量化備忘：假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation.

教學量化備忘：假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work.

教學量化備忘：假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。~Teaching quantitative note: With assumed return volume 0.15 m³ and flow 0.003 m³/s, mean delay is 50 s; advancement at 0.01 m/s shifts assigned depth by 0.50 m.

教學量化備忘：假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow.

教學量化備忘：假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head.
